{{Quote|Do you seriously believe that half a galaxy would side with Nute Gunray because ''all'' those planets, ''all'' their inhabitants are evil?|Cormen A'Lanti|<ref name="The Clone Wars: No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>}}
'''Cormen A'Lanti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Politics/Legends|political]] analyst for [[HoloNet Entertainment]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], A'Lanti questioned the idea that all members of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] were evil and suggested that some people joined the CIS because they disliked the corrupt [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].
